purpose: User-authorized inference-speed-only addendum after training was stopped
hardware: One NVIDIA RTX 4090, selected by observed GPU UUID; sequential subprocesses
checkpoints: Eight baseline configurations at the best mean-F1 learning rate already selected in the report, seed 20261005; Laya completed seed 20261005. Laya seed 20261006 is an additional latency-only check.
input: Existing train-fitted 37-feature representations, 8-flow windows; no test-label tuning
schedule: First 50 batches of epoch 1 from the previously frozen seed 20261005 training schedule
throughput: Inverse of the mean across 50 within-batch median durations, multiplied by logical batch size
latency: p50 and p95 across all 200 individual warm batch-1 requests, including numeric input assembly for TF and CSV serialization/tokenization for Laya, CPU/GPU transfer and CPU probability materialization
exclusions: raw Zeek parsing and train-fitted numeric normalization
latency_scope: Local inference path with one request at a time; not end-to-end response or sustained-load SLA
input_cache: Laya row serialization cache cleared for each serialization-inclusive timed request
runtimes: Original inference paths: TF float32 tf.function and Torch float32 weights with BF16 autocast/SDPA; this compares runnable implementations, not identical numerical kernels
artifacts: Raw per-request durations, hardware/runtime identity, input schedule and weight hashes; checksum confirms unchanged weights
